description: This Java source file defines the ProductionRunServices class, providing various service methods related to manufacturing production runs in Apache OFBiz. The class includes functionalities such as creating, updating, canceling, and changing the status of production runs, as well as cloning related efforts and managing routing tasks.

classes.name: ProductionRunServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for managing production runs in manufacturing, including creation, updating, status changes, and cancellation functionalities.

methods.name: cancelProductionRun
methods.description: Cancels a production run by updating its status and associated routing tasks and products, ensuring dependencies are met.

methods.name: createProductionRun
methods.description: Creates a new production run, including routing tasks, associated products, and components based on BOM and routing definitions.

methods.name: updateProductionRun
methods.description: Updates details of an existing production run, such as quantity, start date, and description, and recalculates related data.

methods.name: changeProductionRunStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of a production run, managing status transitions like scheduled, printed, running, completed, and closed.

methods.name: changeProductionRunTaskStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of individual production run tasks, managing the workflow of production efforts.

methods.name: getWorkEffortCosts
methods.description: Retrieves all cost components related to a specific work effort, summing totals and filtering by date.

methods.name: getProductionRunCost
methods.description: Calculates the total cost associated with a production run, including tasks and header costs.

methods.name: createProductionRunTaskCosts
methods.description: Creates cost components for a production run task based on effort time, with options for custom cost calculation methods.

methods.name: checkUpdatePrunRoutingTask
methods.description: Validates and updates routing task data within a production run, adjusting dates, priorities, and recalculating estimated completion dates.

methods.name: addProductionRunComponent
methods.description: Adds a component (product) to a production run, creating necessary inventory items and associating them with efforts.

methods.name: updateProductionRunComponent
methods.description: Updates an existing component within a production run, modifying associated effort and inventory records.

methods.name: addProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Creates and adds a routing task (work effort) to a production run, setting durations, dates, and copying party assignments.

methods.name: productionRunProduce
methods.description: Records the production of a quantity within a production run, handling inventory item creation, lot management, and effort updates.

methods.name: productionRunDeclareAndProduce
methods.description: Declares additional production quantities, updates effort statuses, and triggers inventory and effort updates.

methods.name: productionRunTaskProduce
methods.description: Produces inventory for a specific production run task, creating inventory items and adjusting effort quantities.

methods.name: productionRunTaskReturnMaterial
methods.description: Handles the return of materials from a production run task back into inventory, updating inventory items and reservations.

methods.name: updateProductionRunTask
methods.description: Updates details, quantities, time entries, and issues required components for a production run task, managing status-dependent behaviors.

methods.name: approveRequirement
methods.description: Approves a manufacturing requirement, updating its status to 'REQ_APPROVED'.

methods.name: createProductionRunFromRequirement
methods.description: Creates a production run directly from an existing requirement, with optional quantity override.

methods.name: createProductionRunFromConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a production run based on a product configuration and its components.

methods.name: quickRunProductionRunTask
methods.description: Quickly advances a production run task to completed status, issuing components if necessary.

methods.name: quickRunAllProductionRunTasks
methods.description: Quickly completes all routing tasks of a production run, issuing components as needed.

methods.name: quickStartAllProductionRunTasks
methods.description: Transitions all scheduled or created tasks in a production run to the running status.

methods.name: quickChangeProductionRunStatus
methods.description: Moves a production run to a specified status rapidly, handling related status changes and task progresses.
